svg.title: Proposed Mini PC AI Lab architecture
svg.desc: Original proposed design, not an observed deployment. Synthetic fixtures pass through a lab client to a dedicated model host and independently checked results.

g.text: Mini PC AI Lab — proposed architecture
PLANNED DESIGN · No existing project connection or deployment claimed
Retain raw timings + configuration + independent correctness checks
Separate serving concurrency, agent completion, build overhead and quality
Inspired by inspected development workflows; private source and assets remain outside the lab.
